description: Prepares a booking for the person who allowed you, for a free time. Nothing is booked yet: it returns a link (`orderUrl`) to give to the person. They read who the seller is and the terms, tick two boxes and press the button, and only then is it booked. Needs the person's own ServeCounter sign-in (OAuth). The booking is always for that person, whatever name or email you send; their phone number and full name are needed only when their account has none. Send an `idempotencyKey` (a new random value for each booking you mean to make) so that asking again after a lost answer is safe: the same key with the same arguments, within 24 hours, gives the first answer again and makes no second order; the same key with other arguments is refused with `idempotency-key-reused`.

idempotencyKey.description: A value you make up once per booking, at most 255 characters, such as a UUID. Send the same one again only to repeat this same call.

name.description: The person's full name, if their account has none.

payment.description: Only where the business lets the customer choose: pay the full amount now, or pay at the business with a deposit now. Defaults to the deposit.

personId.description: Who it is with; leave out for no preference.

phone.description: The person's phone number, if their account has none.

start.description: The start time, HH:MM, from get_free_times.

variantId.description: A variant of the service, when it has them.

name: prepare_booking
title: Prepare Booking
